help.text:
**Shiron** tracks CS2 servers.

**Everyone**
`/map` – live map card (buttons: Players, Refresh, 🔔 Notify me)
`/players` – who is playing
`/notify add` – get alerted when a map comes up (skip server = all servers)
`/notify list` – see, remove and switch your alerts
`/about` – Shiron's version, what's new and stats
`/invite` – add Shiron to your server
`/ping` – check Shiron is online

**Admins (Manage Server)**
`/servers add` – track a CS2 server by IP
`/servers list` – manage servers: channel, card style, min players, remove, map pictures, collections
